PUBLIC UTILITIES COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, DECEMBER 19, 2024
  1800 EAST WARDLOW ROAD
  BOARD ROOM, 9:00 AM

Gina Maguire, President  Naiomi Rainey, Commissioner
Kevin Scott, Vice President  Robert Shannon, Commissioner
Gloria Cordero, Secretary

B. Anatole Falagán, General Manager  Marsha Yasuda, Deputy City Attorney

 CALL TO ORDER

 PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

 ROLL CALL

 REGULAR AGENDA

 1.  24-55918  Recommendation to approve December 5, 2024 Board meeting minutes.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 2.  24-55919  Recommendation to adopt Specifications UD-25-217 and award a contract to Los
  Angeles Truck Centers, LLC, dba Velocity Truck Centers, to furnish and deliver one
  (1) compressed natural gas (CNG) six-yard dump truck, in a total amount not to
  exceed $350,000, and authorize the General Manager to enter into the contract,
  including any documents and necessary subsequent amendments.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 3.  24-55920  Recommendation to adopt Resolution UT-1525 authorizing the General Manager to
  execute an agreement and any amendments with Sonsray Machinery, LLC, for the
  purchase of CASE parts and as-needed repair services for CASE equipment in an
  annual amount not to exceed $200,000 for an initial term of one year, with the
  option to renew for two additional one-year periods at the discretion of the General
  Manager.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 4.  24-55921  Recommendation to adopt Resolution UT-1526 authorizing the General Manager to
  execute a contract, and any necessary documents and subsequent amendments,
  with Ganahl Lumber Company, of Anaheim, CA, for purchase of miscellaneous
  building supplies and materials as-needed, on the same terms and conditions
  afforded to the County of Orange, CA, in an annual amount not to exceed
  $150,000, until the County of Orange, CA contract expires on August 16, 2027, with
  the option to renew for as long as the County of Orange, CA contract is in effect, at
  the discretion of the General Manager.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

  Page 1 of 3
   PUBLIC UTILITIES COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, DECEMBER 19, 2024
  1800 EAST WARDLOW ROAD
  BOARD ROOM, 9:00 AM

5.  24-55922  Recommendation to adopt Resolution UT-1527 authorizing the General Manager to
  execute a contract, and any necessary documents and subsequent amendments,
  with Stuart C. Irby Company, LLC, of Jackson, MS, for furnishing and delivering
  Mueller products, in an annual amount not to exceed $650,000 for a period of one
  year, with the option to renew for two additional one-year periods at the discretion
  of the General Manager.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

6.  24-55923  Recommendation to authorize the General Manager to execute an agreement, and
  any necessary documents and subsequent amendments, with Woodard & Curran,
  Inc., a Maine corporation, to provide professional consulting services to develop a
  2025 Water Resources Plan, in an amount not to exceed $674,245.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

7.  24-55933  Receive verbal presentation – Water Supply Update.

  Suggested Action:  Receive verbal report.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Utilities Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker is limited to
three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Board.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Dynna Long, Executive Secretary, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72 hours prior
to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the Americans
with Disabilities Act, or if you need the agenda provided in an alternate format, please call the Board
of Public Utilities Commissioners Executive Assistant at (562) 570-2435 or (562) 570-6626
(telecommunications for the deaf) by 12 noon, the day prior to the meeting.
